purpose: Add an elastic KDP-specific render gate without hard-wiring KDP rules into the literary/master function.

official_evidence.finding: Paperback custom trim range is 4-8.5 inches wide by 6-11.69 inches high; sizes over 6.12 wide or 9 high are large trim.
Bleed manuscripts add 0.125 inch to width and 0.25 inch to height; outside margins are at least 0.25 no-bleed or 0.375 with bleed; gutter minimum rises by page-count band.
official_evidence.source: KDP Set Trim Size, Bleed, and Margins / Paperback Submission Guidelines

official_evidence.finding: EPUB is supported for ebooks and KDP recommends checking the file with Kindle Previewer.

end_user_evidence.finding: Recent KDP users repeatedly report bleed/page-size mismatch and gutter/page-count mistakes as rejection or preview problems.
Operators report that a clean preview does not always eliminate the need to verify actual page dimensions and bleed before final publication.

elastic_design: KDP constraints live in a dated adapter/gate that can be replaced when Amazon changes rules.
Trim choice is not forced by the master function.
Gutter is not guessed before pagination; the gate returns NEEDS_PAGINATION until page count exists.
EPUB and paperback remain separate render paths.

current_result.paperback: KDP gate ready; first actual Sleepy Hollow print render still needs trim choice plus test pagination.
current_result.ebook: KDP EPUB render contract ready for a future test render.
